Changes in the Suominen Leadership Team

As we continue to transform Suominen and strengthen our performance, we are further developing the capabilities and ways of working needed to execute our strategy and realize the full potential of our business.
To strengthen our strategic execution and the leadership needed to drive this change, we are making changes in the Suominen Leadership Team, effective September 17, 2026.

, Senior Vice President, Commercial Excellence and Strategic Projects, has been appointed Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer (CSTO) and member of the Suominen Leadership Team. In her new role, Eeva will report to President and CEO

Eevaleena brings international experience in strategic and transformation projects from both management consulting and the process industry. Prior to Suominen, she worked in strategy, sustainability and business leadership roles at Huhtamäki. Her background also includes management consulting at Bain & Company.

“I’m pleased to welcome Eevaleena to our team. She has a significant track record in raising strategic programs, bringing people together, planning and executing complex cross-functional initiatives”, says

Suominen manufactures nonwovens as roll goods for wipes and other applications. Our vision is to be the frontrunner for nonwovens innovation and sustainability. The end products made of Suominen’s nonwovens are present in people’s daily life worldwide.
